title: GovernanceAccountability
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — management body governance accountability under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Defines the vocabulary for management body obligations: approval of risk-management measures, mandatory training, and personal liability acknowledgement. Rootless — regulatory governance dimension. Source: NIS2 Article 20.

managementApproval.description: Whether management bodies have formally approved the cybersecurity risk-management measures. Source: NIS2 Art 20(1).

trainingCompleted.description: Whether members of management bodies have completed mandatory cybersecurity training to gain sufficient knowledge and skills to identify risks and assess cybersecurity risk-management practices. Source: NIS2 Art 20(2).

employeeTrainingOffered.description: Whether the entity offers similar training to employees on a regular basis. Source: NIS2 Art 20(2) (second sentence).

liabilityAcknowledged.description: Whether management body members have acknowledged personal liability for infringements of Article 21. Member States ensure management bodies can be held liable per national law. Source: NIS2 Art 20(1) (final sentence).
